$comment: Records in `modules::registry::ALL` whose submodule pin deliberately does
NOT sit on the tag their `version` names. See scripts/ci/check-module-pins.mjs.
An entry here is a claim that the drift is known and accepted, NOT a way to
silence the gate: `expect` pins the exact `git describe --tags` output, so a
record already exempt cannot drift FURTHER without failing. Widening the drift
is a deliberate edit to this file, which is a reviewable diff.
Delete an entry the moment the pins are reconciled. An exemption that has
stopped being true fails the gate too — `expect` must still match.

exemptions.reason: The main-branch TinyMCP submodule pin includes upstream changes after PR #30, while no matching tinymcp module release and digest have been published, plus tinymcp#33 (branch w4-mcp-hosts): the optional library-only `tools` additions `tinymcp::tools::{SecretScrubber, McpListServersTool, McpListToolsTool, McpCallTool}`, which the core links as a Rust path dependency and which the loadable module artifact does not build (the feature is off for the cdylib). Keep the registry artifact pinned to the verified v0.3.5 release and remove this exact source/artifact drift exemption when a matching release and digest are available.

The pin is v0.2.7 plus only the new pure-library crate tinyruntime-pyserver (tinyhumansai/tinyruntime#19, branch oh-pyserver-on-v0.2.7), which the core links as a Rust path dependency for runtime::python_server. No module, contract or bus source changes relative to v0.2.7, so the registry's artifact still matches the contract compiled here. Remove when tinyruntime#19 ships in a release and both pins move to it.

The provider is published independently at v0.2.3 while the shared source pin is tinyruntime v0.2.7. v0.2.3 was built against tinyruntime 09f9646 (v0.2.4-5); git diff 09f9646..v0.2.7 changes no crate source (only CI, toolchain, versions, Cargo.lock and the tinybus pin), and the tinybus module ABI is revision 1 on both. Registry retains its matching published v0.2.3 provider artifact.
